title: cmux NEXT customization samples
description: Small, live examples that connect cmux to the work already in your sessions.
install: Copy a template into ~/.config/cmux/customize, or install a sample app from the App Store.
reload: Save the file; cmux reloads the local view without a restart. Use cmux apps reload for a manual refresh.

samples.title: My PRs
samples.description:
Keep your pull requests and review requests in the sidebar.
Open a PR in a cmux browser tab with one click.

samples.title: Agent threads
samples.description:
Turn live agent state into a needs-you-first sidebar.
Jump straight to the terminal behind a chat.

samples.title: Quick links
samples.description:
Keep Figma, Linear, docs, and dashboards beside your code.
The same tiny view works as a sidebar section and a pane.

samples.title: GitHub PRs
samples.description:
Read real pull requests through cmux.watch and keep the list live.
Click a row to open the matching browser tab.

samples.title: Session branch PRs
samples.description:
Show the pull requests for the branch behind the current chat.
The Session Info section receives the real session context.

samples.title: Running agents
samples.description:
Group agents by working, waiting, idle, and done.
A click focuses the terminal that owns the agent.

samples.title: Command buttons
samples.description:
Put the commands you run all day in one sidebar section.
Each button uses the same cmux-next.json action as Cmd+K and shortcuts.

samples.title: Design links
samples.description:
Paste a Figma, FigJam, Linear, Notion, or Docs URL.
The link is saved locally and opens in a cmux browser tab.

samples.title: Clock and weather
samples.description:
A real clock plus a city weather lookup, stored on this Mac.
It demonstrates timers, network scopes, storage, and a live reloadable view.

samples.title: Standup notes
samples.description:
Add, list, and clear a tiny standup log from the palette or CLI.
It is a real storage-backed app with no UI to maintain.

apiGaps.note: github.pulls has no CI/check-run fields yet; add a signal before advertising CI badges.
New-agent actions do not accept a prompt or diff attachment yet.
cmux.status/1 validates, but NEXT does not render titlebar or chat-toolbar contributions.
workspaceCommand/workspace layout actions remain classic-only on NEXT.
Session Info has no per-chat token or cost signal.
